options.text: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.

questions.explanation: You are traveling the wrong way on this road. Turn around immediately.

questions.explanation: The divided highway is ending ahead. Be ready to change lanes or adjust your position.

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter. You may see it on one-way streets or when entering expressway ramps in the wrong direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You are leaving a one-way road. You will soon drive on a two-way highway with traffic in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of an upcoming curve to the right.

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road. If you see this sign facing you, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around.

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Treat a flashing red light like a stop sign. Stop completely, then yield to all traffic and pedestrians before entering.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: A divided highway is starting ahead. Keep to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop. Never try to drive faster than an oncoming train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means do not pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn, as long as you yield to others drivers.
Come to a full stop and proceed when it is safe.
Come to a full stop and remain stopped while the red arrow is activated.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and remain stopped while the red arrow is activated.
questions.explanation: A red arrow pointing left means stop completely before the intersection or crosswalk. Stay stopped until the red arrow is no longer displayed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you a yield sign is coming up. Start to slow down when you see it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful. You do not have to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs mark school zones and school crossings. Watch for children and obey the posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to conditions immediately ahead. This sign tells you to slow down and prepare for a sharp change in direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs mark work zones. Stay alert when you see orange signs, cones, or barrels. This sign warns that a flagger is ahead, and you must follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right, then curves left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to conditions immediately ahead. Speed plaques on these signs show the safe speed to use.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Do not turn right at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits left turns. Do not turn left at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Round signs are used only to warn about railroad crossings. Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to hazards ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to conditions immediately ahead. This sign tells you to prepare for traffic merging from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped yellow signs warn of possible danger ahead. Orange diamond-shaped signs warn of dangers in or near work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop to let any vehicle, bicyclist, or pedestrian pass. You do not have the right-of-way.
